body: TEST-SURFACE ADDENDUM: these are not merely untested branches; two current tests ratify the wrong estimands. InterviewSuite:891-904 explicitly requires 0.5 repetition + 0.5 semantic under Ignore to become semantic=1.0. InterviewProfileSuite:222-236 explicitly requires 0.105 Unresolved to leave eventPurity=1.0 and otherEventDrift=0.0, i.e. discarded placement uncertainty is asserted as invariant. The Missing test at InterviewSuite:936-946 checks Coverage(1,0) only and never inspects ExpectedCount intervals or hard totals, so zero/[0,0]/hard=0 passes unchallenged. Capacity-to-fail requirements for the eventual fixes should therefore include exact adversarial outputs, not only new metadata fields: 0.5 retained mass stays 0.5; unresolved mass changes the typed resolution summary; one assessment never yields hard total >1; all-Missing widens/abstains rather than yielding a closed zero; partial audio cannot inflate an unconditional per-second density. Mutation targets should alter each arithmetic expression, not merely remove validation guards.
